findings: Nudge: whole family is OFF on this set. Live luna getSystemSettings: general.aiNudge=off and general.aiChannel=off; nu_default requires nudgeSetting=true. configd nudge.blacklist also lists nu_amazon_entry, nu_tv_on_1, nu_ch_zapping, nu_watch_tv_end_1, nu_tv_on_magic, nu_watch_tv_live_ott, nu_object_audio.

Nudge mechanism: com.webos.service.nudge (native /usr/sbin/nudge) pushes JSON to NudgeServiceModel, which calls systemUIManager/launch for com.webos.app.nudge; input apps (livetv/hdmi, inputcommon NudgeInterfaces) call requestNudge. Strings are built by the requester or nudge l10n, so a replacement must implement the getNudgeInfo/responseNudge protocol or leave the setting off.

Nudge is suppressed over Home, overlay, alerts, voice agent, ScreenRemote and keyboard (StarfishNudgeView.isSystemAllowable) unless priority=urgent; it is closed by Back/Exit/CH keys, CP hotkeys, suspend. A LumaTV home/overlay counts only if it mimics those view states.

SportsAlarm: cannot appear here. sportsAlarm=on but mySportTeamList is empty, no ThinQ/account known; also needs the sportsalarm push service. Launch path [INFERENCE]: nudge customNudgeMain (configd entry has no main). SportsAlarm/qmldir is a copy of StoreStreamer's ('module StoreStreamer'); 6+ files (AlarmTile, ExceptionsPopup, AnimationItem...) are unreferenced.

CoverUI (com.webos.app.cpcover) IS a boot dependency, not just a screen: opened by bootd via luna com.webos.coverUI/open, it launches the first app and emits bootd signals smart-service-ready and firstapp-launched; if it is stubbed, boot/IBD sequencing may stall. It also blocks all keys while open (StarfishKeyFilter) and handles screen-saver wake via launchFallback.
CoverUI block screen (stolen/rental) cannot appear on an unflagged TV; 'Loading...' text is hidden only on BNO (Bang & Olufsen) models, so on this OLED it shows.

RemoteUserList: only PinPopup (mobile pairing PIN, overlay) and miracast toasts are live; Tooltip, TooltipRTL, Delegate, Model, Shadow, OpacityMaskImage, Style are unreferenced in the whole qml tree. Appears only if a phone starts ThinQ/LG TV Plus pairing; rollingscreen.supportScreenType=none here.

Voice/VoiceAgent: Voice key (MRCU mic) goes keyfilter -> voiceconductor setInputEvent hold; configd com.webos.keyaction.voice = launch com.webos.app.voice (native 'Search' overlay), and voiceconductor separately launches the voiceagent bar via sysuicompmgr. The 1954 VoiceAgent files are 10 qml, 1940 PNG animation frames (4 res x 485) and 3 PCM earcons. Voice module = native QOpusPlayer only.

FavoriteChannels (My Channels) is a Live-TV-channel ribbon for the Home bottom wedge (wedgeBottom=myChannels, showFavChannelsUI/showFavProgramsUI true). Nothing in compositor qml or KeyFilters reads those keys or this module, so a native/Home host loads it [INFERENCE]; Favorite key only opens seniorfavoritechannels in Simple Mode (appLaunch.js) and is blocked on tunerless sets. iepg getChannelList returned no channelId, so it would show the empty state; Nitin rarely uses antenna.

configd keys not consumed by any compositor qml or key filter found: enableMyStarter, enableMusicButton, showFavChannelsUI, showFavProgramsUI, wedgeBottom, keepAliveFavProgramsApp (native consumers). pinnedAppsOnAODBoot (voice, aiplatform, assistants) only keeps those overlays open on surface add (StarfishViewStateController); blockKeyFilterNonCardTypeApps=[remotecontrolguide] blocks key filters while that app is foreground (preProcess handleKeyBlockByApp).

StoreStreamer cannot appear: retail-demo eStreamer strip started by store-demo; TV storeMode=home. Eos is toolkit only (Controls 41, Items 11, Style 17 qml + 3 native plugins); Launcher, AdvancedAlertDelegate (alerts), ContextMenu and My Channels use its widgets. Libraries (QmlAppComponents*, WebOS, WebOSServices, iLib, QtQuick*, Qt* plugins) have no own surface; WebOS DeveloperTools consoles are off by default (logConsole/resourceMonitor/fpsGraphOverlay=false).

configd systemUIManager appinfo: QuickSettings main already points to /var/lib/lumaglass/systemui/...; keyFilters runs handleLumaHome (/var/lib/lumaglass/keyfilter/lumaglass.js) first. Nudge, store-streamer, mobileconnection still use stock /usr/lib/qt5/qml paths; cpcover is built into the compositor (starfishCoverUI), not in that list.
